I will give him a white stone () = truths supporting and united to good. A white stone has this signification because they took the votes by means of stones in their judgments, and the confirming ones by means of white stones.
On the skill of calculating in the Spiritual World.

I will give him a white, stone = wisdom and intelligence. A white stone, when given by the Lord, = reception from Him and influx... The reason a white stone has this signification, is that in judgments they took the votes by means of stones, the affirmative sentences by white stones, and the negative ones by black stones: hence by a white stone is signified the reception of wisdom and intelligence.
